description: bellbook-core-v1 profile vectors: each receipt paired with the exact profile result (status and per-clause pass flags) the profile must yield; every failable clause has a rejecting case.

cases.name: clean-baseline-conformant
cases.description: A Clean line committed under rules with the baseline thresholds: every clause holds.

cases.name: tainted-still-conformant
cases.description: The evaluator retracts its evaluation: the receipt is Tainted, and Tainted conforms (B1 admits it). Conformance is about the rule shape, not the absence of retractions.

cases.name: missing-thresholds-fails-b3
cases.description: Valid rules without evidence thresholds: the log verifies Clean, but the rules admit assumption-class evolution records, so B3 fails and nothing else does.

cases.name: weaker-than-base-threshold-fails-b3
cases.description: A Selection threshold of Assumed is present but weaker than the schema base class (Inferred): B3 fails.

cases.name: context-bound-zero-fails-b4
cases.description: max_context_records of 0 is outside the declared range: B4 fails while the thresholds (B3) hold.

cases.name: empty-log-empty-roles-fails-b2
cases.description: An empty log validates Clean, but rules that register no author role compare nothing: B2 fails.

cases.name: invalid-receipt-fails-b1
cases.description: One payload byte altered: the receipt parses, replay rejects it, and B1 fails. B6 reports no accepted candidates because a rejected log made no claims.
